Markets.title: MakeMyTrip's India arm gets Sebi nod to float IPO
Markets.summary: MakeMyTrip's Indian subsidiary, MMT India, has received regulatory approval from Sebi for an initial public offering. The IPO will consist of equity shares sold by MakeMyTrip and ibibo Group Holdings to boost the parent company's cash position.

Markets.title: Indian bonds drift with oil; inflation data in focus
Markets.summary: Indian government bonds remained largely steady as oil prices stabilized and investors awaited upcoming U.S. and Indian inflation data. The market is also preparing for a 290.5 billion rupee bond auction scheduled for later today.

Markets.title: Explained: Why Nvidia shares dropped 4% in overnight trade and what analysts warn can trigger a bloodbath?
Markets.summary: Nvidia shares dropped over 4% in overnight trade after CEO Jensen Huang acknowledged a relationship with a Chinese national, raising security concerns. The company has launched an investigation, though the board believes no secrets were compromised.

Markets.title: Nvidia stock in focus: 3 key risks after Jensen Huang probe

Markets.title: Nuvama Wealth Management Q2 Results: Profit rises 19% YoY to Rs 304 crore
Markets.summary: Nuvama Wealth Management reported a 19% year-on-year increase in consolidated net profit to Rs 303.5 crore for Q2 FY27. Revenue grew by 20.35% to Rs 1,366 crore, driven by growth in wealth management, asset services, and capital markets.

Data & Insights.title: India's forex reserves fall $2.69 billion to $717 billion: Why RBI is selling dollars and what it means for the rupee
Data & Insights.summary: India's foreign exchange reserves dropped by $2.69 billion to $717.06 billion in the week ending October 30 due to central bank dollar sales and asset valuation changes. The Reserve Bank of India is actively selling dollars to manage volatility and support the rupee against depreciation pressures.

Data & Insights.title: Iran war: IOC to buy crude, LPG carriers as Strait of Hormuz disruptions drive freight costs
Data & Insights.summary: Indian Oil Corporation plans to purchase crude and LPG carriers and explore domestic shipbuilding to counter surging freight costs caused by Strait of Hormuz disruptions. This initiative supports the company's broader strategy to diversify crude supplies, build inventories, and strengthen its energy supply chain.

Data & Insights.title: The midterms give Fed more room to raise rates, mut maybe less reason to do so
Data & Insights.summary: Midterm election results suggest a slowdown in datacenter spending. This reduction could help curb inflation, giving the Federal Reserve more room to raise interest rates.

Data & Insights.title: No fresh curbs on broken rice exports as India banks on steady paddy procurement
Data & Insights.summary: India has no plans to restrict broken rice exports following the removal of its previous ban on March 7, 2025. This decision is supported by the country's steady paddy procurement.

Data & Insights.title: Bond yield rise squeezes banks' Q2 treasury gains
Data & Insights.summary: Rising bond yields caused public and private banks to report losses on their treasury income during the second quarter. This elevated yield environment may continue to pressure bank earnings through the December quarter.

Data & Insights.title: Internship scheme's new pilot gets more takers post rejig
Data & Insights.summary: About 40,000 candidates have joined the third pilot round of the PM Internship Scheme, which is 2.5 times the total turnout of the first two rounds. This positive response has encouraged the corporate affairs ministry to consider launching the full program next year without additional pilot rounds.
